title: Grade 4 Math — Tue, May 19
description: Fractions — Day 2 of 5: Equivalent fractions and comparing
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2?
questions.explanation: 2/4 = 1/2. Multiply both numerator and denominator of 1/2 by 2: 1×2/2×2 = 2/4.

questions.question: Are 3/4 and 6/8 equivalent?
options: Only if they have the same denominator
questions.explanation: Yes! 6/8 = 3/4. Multiply 3/4 by 2/2 = 6/8. Or divide 6/8 by 2/2 = 3/4.

questions.question: Which is the simplest form of 4/8?
questions.explanation: 4/8 → divide both by 4 → 1/2. Or divide by 2 twice: 4/8 → 2/4 → 1/2. Simplest form = 1/2.

questions.question: Which fraction is LARGER: 1/2 or 1/4?
questions.explanation: 1/2 > 1/4. When numerators are equal (both 1), the one with the SMALLER denominator is LARGER. Half a pizza is more than a quarter.

questions.question: Which fraction is SMALLER: 3/5 or 3/7?
questions.explanation: 3/7 < 3/5. Same numerators — larger denominator means smaller fraction (each piece is smaller).

questions.question: What is the simplest form of 6/9?
questions.explanation: 6/9 — GCD of 6 and 9 is 3. Divide both by 3: 6÷3 / 9÷3 = 2/3.

questions.question: Compare: 2/3 and 3/4. Which is larger?
questions.explanation: To compare, make same denominator: 2/3 = 8/12, 3/4 = 9/12. So 3/4 > 2/3.

questions.question: Which is the simplest form of 10/15?
How do you find equivalent fractions?
options: Add the same number to both numerator and denominator
Multiply OR divide both numerator and denominator by the same non-zero number
Subtract the same number from both
questions.explanation: Multiply (or divide) BOTH numerator and denominator by the same number. 1/2 × 3/3 = 3/6 ✓ vs 1/2 + 1/1 = 2/3 ✗

questions.question: Which fraction is the largest: 1/2, 1/3, or 1/6?
questions.explanation: 1/2 is largest. With same numerator (1), smaller denominator = larger fraction. 1/2 > 1/3 > 1/6.

questions.question: Arrange in ascending order: 1/4, 1/2, 1/8, 1/3
questions.explanation: Same numerator (1) → largest denominator is smallest fraction. 1/8 < 1/4 < 1/3 < 1/2.
